id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

parent.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} linked to this alert.

triggeringModel.description: The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} which triggered this alert.

featureContributionMap.description:
Direct mapping of feature name to value based off of the feature contributions associated with the alert.
These feature contributions are normalized and they add up to 1.
They are displayed on the contributions grid on the alert detail page.

primaryModelOutput.description:
A field capturing information about the model output for the {@link timestamp} that the alert is raised.
Supports multiple formats for display in the UI.

allPrimaryModelOutputs.description:
A field capturing information about the model output for the {@link timestamp} that the alert is raised.
Supports multiple formats for display in the UI.

title:
Generic type of alert that contains the shared fields found in both "real" ({@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}) and
validation alerts ({@link ReliabilityAssetValidationAlert}).
It is associated with a particular {@link ReliabilityAsset}, indicating abnormal behavior in a specific attribute,
and is based on a {@ReliabilityMlModel} that defines the criteria for triggering the alert.

This type is abstract and should not be used directly. Instead, use one of the concrete subtypes.
name: ReliabilityAssetAlertBase
